AI ASSISTANT

MY ORDER ARRIVED AND ONE ITEM IS DAMAGED, WHAT DO I DO?
I’m sorry your item arrived damaged. Please start a request through our RETURN PORTAL and select the reason that matches the damage. Include a brief description, a photo of the item, and a photo of the care tag inside the garment. Our team will review the request and, if approved, email you a prepaid label.
